findings.title: Trailing experience metadata breaks Native app-server input-question parsing
findings.requirement: The completion metadata addition must preserve existing Native app-server question handoff behavior.
findings.evidence: The completion parser strips the metadata into report.summary, but the Native helper path was passed the original final_response. Native _json_report expects a standalone JSON/verdict result; input_question returns None when the trailing metadata makes JSON parsing fail.
findings.consequence: A Native run that reports BLOCKED_INPUT may not persist or yield its question for the user and may proceed to ordinary completion handling.
findings.minimum_change: Pass report.summary to Native validation and question parsing, or strip the metadata in Native parsing before evaluating the original blocker report.
